purpose: Measure whether V44 replacement ordering is materially affected by exact cons_min ties. Do not use returns to choose a tie-break.
input: V44 Top-K candidate pool before outcome columns are consulted
metrics: fraction_of selected replacement decisions whose chosen cons_min is tied with another currently eligible candidate

interpretation.no_or_rare_ties: V44 symbol-code final tie-break is operationally negligible.
interpretation.material_ties: V44 remains descriptive but cannot be promoted until a new outcome-blind deterministic secondary score is preregistered and tested on later data.

restrictions: Do not compare historical returns across alternative tie-breaks in this audit.
Do not select cons_geo/r_ret/p_hit10/etc. as a new tie-break from V44 outcomes.
Do not alter the running authoritative V44 experiment.
